title: JFK assassination linked to the UAP topic, read from Kash Patel's remarks

tellings.quote: But what I hear him saying cryptically is that the JFK assassination is linked to the UAP topic.

plain: The 1963 assassination of John F. Kennedy in Dallas may be linked to UAP, the government's term for UFOs (unidentified anomalous phenomena), according to Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he once helped retrieve a UFO. Barber tells Michels this is his own reading of cryptic remarks Kash Patel made about the JFK files: "what I hear him saying cryptically is that the JFK assassination is linked to the UAP topic." If he read Patel rightly, it would tie one of America's best-known murders to secrets about these objects.
